name: chat
title: Chat
summary: People message each other one to one and in groups, with photos and files, replies, reactions, read state and live delivery.

env.name: CHAT_GROUP_MAX_MEMBERS
env.doc: Most people in one group conversation, owner included.

env.name: CHAT_EDIT_WINDOW
env.doc: How long after sending a message its sender can edit it (Go duration; 0 turns editing off).

env.name: CHAT_NEW_CONVERSATIONS_PER_DAY
env.doc: Conversations one person can start in a rolling 24 hours (reopening an existing one is free).

env.name: CHAT_MESSAGES_PER_MINUTE
env.doc: Messages one person can send per minute, across all conversations.

env.name: CHAT_ATTACHMENT_MAX_MB
env.doc: Largest file a message can carry, in MB.

stitch: Decide who may message whom: chat.SetContactPolicy (default: any active user not blocked either way). The people picker searches names and exact emails; replace /v1/chat/people if the app has its own directory.
Decide whether people added to a group see earlier history (default yes).
Link to POST /v1/chat/conversations {kind: direct, user_id} from profiles and other features, then open /chat/<id>.
Add to the privacy policy that message text appears in push notifications.
If you change CHAT_ATTACHMENT_MAX_MB or CHAT_EDIT_WINDOW, update CHAT_ATTACHMENT_MAX_BYTES (shared) and EDIT_WINDOW_MS (web, mobile).
